svg.text: ESP32-S3 CAM + PCM5102A | Squeezelite Dual Player Wiring
Freenove ESP32-S3 CAM (x2) + Teyleten PCM5102A I2S DAC (x2) on 400-tie Breadboards
I2S: BCLK=GPIO40 WS=GPIO41 DOUT=GPIO42 | DAC VIN: 3.3V | SCK->GND (int. PLL) | XSMT bridge: set HIGH to unmute
> BREADBOARD WIRING DIAGRAMS (top view - identical for both players)
> SCHEMATIC DIAGRAM (one player shown - both identical)
> CONNECTION TABLE (per player - repeat identically for Player 2)
Breadboard left + rail -> DAC right + rail
Both GND rails bridged at bottom
Tie to GND -> enables internal PLL
Solder pad: bridge to GND for I2S
Solder pad: bridge to 3.3V to unmute
(no I2C needed - PCM5102A is I2S only)
ESP32-S3 CAM uses PSRAM on GPIO 26-32
-> these GPIOs must NOT be used for I2S
-> I2S on 40/41/42 has zero conflict OK
Feed USB-C into ESP32; 3.3V from on-board LDO -> DAC
Add 100nF cap across DAC VCC/GND near the module
PCM5102A draws ~15mA; ESP LDO handles it fine
Camera and audio can run simultaneously; separate tasks
CAM board has PSRAM; Squeezelite uses it for audio buffer
Set XMT pad HIGH (3.3V) - factory default is muted!
FMT=GND selects I2S format; FLT=GND = normal roll-off
3.5mm jack on DAC is line-level; add amp for speakers
Hold BOOT (GPIO0) + press RESET to enter flash mode
Both players are wired identically; flash each separately
> FREENOVE ESP32-S3 CAM - GPIO USAGE MAP (inferred from board documentation)
[X] Camera GPIOs - DO NOT USE for I2S
[OK] Safe GPIOs for I2S + Other Uses
Generated for: Freenove ESP32-S3 CAM + Teyleten PCM5102A | Squeezelite-ESP32 Dual Player
Pinout inferred from Freenove FNK0093 documentation. Verify SCK/FMT/XMT solder bridges on your specific PCM5102A module revision.
Pin header (left->right): SCK | BCK | DIN | LRCK | GND | VIN
FLT / DEMP / XSMT(SMT) / FMT are solder-bridge pads on the PCB body -- NOT header pins
ACTION: Verify SMT bridge is in H (HIGH/3.3V) position -- LOW position = soft-muted, no audio!
